bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; mining; extending the expiration of funds to the city of Eveleth.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+IRON RANGE RESOURCES AND REHABILITATION; EXTENDING BONDS AUTHORIZED IN 2024. +]

[+Notwithstanding Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 69, section 15, subdivision 1, paragraph (d), funds distributed under Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 69, section 15, subdivision 3, paragraph (a), clauses (13) and (26), are available until March 30, 2030. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; mining; extending the expiration of funds to the city of Eveleth.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. IRON RANGE RESOURCES AND REHABILITATION; EXTENDING BONDS AUTHORIZED IN 2024.

Notwithstanding Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 69, section 15, subdivision 1, paragraph (d), funds distributed under Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 69, section 15, subdivision 3, paragraph (a), clauses (13) and (26), are available until March 30, 2030.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: IRON RANGE RESOURCES AND REHABILITATION; EXTENDING BONDS AUTHORIZED IN 2024.

Notwithstanding Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 69, section 15, subdivision 1, paragraph (d), funds distributed under Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 69, section 15, subdivision 3, paragraph (a), clauses (13) and (26), are available until March 30, 2030.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
